cpu.microarchitecture: Apple Silicon (Apple M4), heterogeneous P/E core clusters

software.os_kernel_version: Darwin Kernel Version 24.5.0: Tue Apr 22 19:54:43 PDT 2025; root:xnu-11417.121.6~2/RELEASE_ARM64_T8132

notes: Nominal CPU frequency is not exposed by sysctl on Apple Silicon.
No L3 reported: Apple Silicon uses a system-level cache (SLC) shared with the GPU instead of a classic L3.
Cache line is 128 bytes on this CPU, so false-sharing padding must be 16 x int64, not 8 x int64.
Heterogeneous cores: scaling beyond the performance-core count will schedule work onto slower efficiency cores.
